description: Language support for Ekips Prime Pro (.ekips), the robot language for the LEGO SPIKE Prime hub.
config.lsp.enabled: Start the Ekips language server (error checking, autocomplete, hover help).
config.lsp.path: Path to the `ekips-lsp` program from [Ekips Prime Pro Tools](https://github.com/Ekips-Prime-Pro/Ekips-Prime-Pro-Tools). Leave empty to search the `PATH` and `~/.cargo/bin`. Relative paths are resolved against the first workspace folder.
config.cli.path: Path to the `ekips` command-line program (used by **Ekips: Check File**). Leave empty to search the `PATH` and `~/.cargo/bin`.
config.messages.language: Language of error messages from the compiler and the language server.
config.messages.language.auto: Same as the VS Code display language
config.trace.server: Log the communication with the language server in the output panel (for debugging).
